issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Farm song method: the problem statement and template declare and document a public method named singFarmSong(), but the solution implementation provides a public method named playFarmSong() instead. Problem statement: instructs implement singFarmSong() (problem_statement.md lines 112-116). Template: declares public void singFarmSong() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java lines 9-11). Solution: provides public void playFarmSong() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java lines 59-64). This naming inconsistency can confuse students which method to implement and will break tests or example usage that expect singFarmSong().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API consistent: rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public void singFarmSong() wrapper in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong(). Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to refer to playFarmSong() — preferred fix is to rename the solution method to public void singFarmSong() so it matches the problem specification and template.

issues.description: Public method naming mismatch for the Farm song operation: the problem statement and the template expect a public method named singFarmSong(), but the solution implements this operation as a public method named playFarmSong() (the solution also contains a private helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal)). Specifically: problem statement/template refer to singFarmSong(); solution provides playFarmSong(). This divergence makes it unclear which public API students must implement and will cause tests or example code calling singFarmSong() to fail or confuse students mapping requirements to the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong() (and update any internal callers or tests). Alternatively, if playFarmSong() is the preferred name, update the problem statement and the template to reference playFarmSong() instead — but ensure all three artifacts (problem, template, solution) use the same identifier.
